_readme: Persistent source for the drift guard's EXISTING --allow mechanism (see scripts/lib/gate-exemptions.js).
The guard only accepts --allow / GATE_CLOSE_ALLOW for a single invocation; a push runs it from the
pre-push hook, so an exemption that must hold for every future push has to be committed here.
NARROW BY CONSTRUCTION: exact SHAs only (no paths/globs/ranges), and every entry needs a non-empty
reason + workstream + authority or it is IGNORED. It only ADDS to the allow set — every other
unlisted commit still classifies as DRIFT.
FORBIDDEN USE: never add an entry to silence real drift in a workstream that project_checklist_items
is supposed to track. Sync that row instead. Exemptions are for commits that legitimately belong to
